title: Subtle Biases Need Subtler Measures: Dual Metrics for Evaluating Representative and Affinity Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring representative bias by calculating the semantic similarity between race-prompted (e.g., White, Black, Asian) and default text generations, and affinity bias by prompting the model to evaluate and select its preferred output from those generated across different racial identities.

Measuring representative bias by calculating the semantic similarity between gender-prompted (e.g., man, woman, non-binary) and default text generations, and affinity bias by prompting the model to evaluate and select its preferred output from those generated across different gender identities.

Measuring representative bias by calculating the semantic similarity between sexual orientation-prompted (e.g., straight, queer) and default text generations, and affinity bias by prompting the model to evaluate and select its preferred output from those generated across different sexual orientation identities.
